title: Where does this instruction go?
intro: You want Claude to remember something. Pick the instruction and see which file it belongs in.

inputs.label: Instruction
options: I prefer short commit messages (all my projects)
Run tests with pnpm test (whole team)
My local database runs on port 5433 (just me, this project)
Never touch the migrations folder (must be enforced)

when.equals: I prefer short commit messages (all my projects)

show.title: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md
show.detail: Your user file is loaded in every project, so personal preferences go there.

trace.text: Loads it at the start of every session, in any project.

when.equals: Run tests with pnpm test (whole team)

show.title: ./CLAUDE.md in the project
show.detail: The project file is committed with the code, so everyone's sessions read the same commands and conventions.

trace.text: Loads it for anyone working in this repository.

when.equals: My local database runs on port 5433 (just me, this project)

show.title: ./CLAUDE.local.md
show.detail: A local file holds notes that are personal to you in this project. Add it to .gitignore so it isn't shared.

trace.text: Loads it alongside the project file.

when.equals: Never touch the migrations folder (must be enforced)

show.title: Use a rule, not memory
show.detail: CLAUDE.md is guidance Claude reads, not a guarantee. For something that must never happen, add a deny permission rule or a hook.

fallback.title: Pick an option
fallback.detail: Choose an instruction to see where it belongs.

quiz.question: You start Claude Code in a subfolder of a project. Which CLAUDE.md files load at launch?
options: Only the one in the current folder
The ones in the current folder and every folder above it
quiz.explanation: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md files from the working folder up through its parents and combines them. Files in subfolders below load when Claude works there.
